g.text: AI Security Engineer. I red-team large language models and the agents built on them.
Before this, computer vision — where adversarial examples were first found.
The method did not change when the input became language.
A VESSEL IS ONLY AS GOOD AS ITS SEAL
92 public repositories, drawn as Hallownest. Every room is one repository.
Areas are inferred from repository names and descriptions, and placed after Hallownest — Foundations where Dirtmouth stands, Computer Vision in Greenpath's place, AI Security in the Abyss.
What there is, where the work went, and when it happened.
